verdict.rationale: Conductor is built to run many coding agents in parallel: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode each work in their own isolated worktree, branch and workspace. Cloud sandboxes keep working after you close your laptop, and agents can run builds and tests without per-step confirmation. Workspaces can also be created programmatically through the API or started on a schedule with routines, and community comments confirm the parallel-worktree model. missing for 10: explicit evidence of runs lasting hours or days, documented limits on fleet size or concurrency, and independent hands-on corroboration of long-running unattended cloud agents.
